example.title: Wells County Bridge No. 74, County Road 400 West over Rock Creek Ditch
example.place: Bluffton vicinity, Liberty Township, Wells County, IN

brief: Single-span, five-panel pin-connected steel Pratt pony truss, 72 ft long with a 14 ft plank deck, set on cut-stone abutments over a straightened drainage creek with steep grassy banks. Riveted I-section top chord, T-section verticals of two angles laced with flat bar, paired drawn-bar diagonals crossing in the centre panel, stirrup hangers carrying I-beam floor beams and five stringers; portal posts land on cast-iron shoes. Latticed guard rails run about 3 ft above the deck on the inner faces; hazard boards mark the corners. Carries a narrow broken-asphalt/gravel county road past a farmstead with a gable-roofed barn on the bluff beside it, flat ploughed fields all round.
